note: Real astronaut facts. The game shows these through src/i18n/strings.ts (fact.*) so they can be translated; this file keeps the sources together for the team.

facts.text: NASA does not let an astronaut collect more than 600 mSv of space radiation in their whole career. One big solar storm must stay under 250 mSv.
NASA's Curiosity rover measured the radiation on Mars: about 0.64 mSv every day.
In 2015, astronauts on the space station ate red lettuce they grew in space. It grew for 33 days in a plant box called Veggie.
